SELECT po.purchase_order_id, po.order_no, po.supplier_id, bp.partner_name AS supplier_name, po.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, po.order_date, po.expected_delivery_date, po.approval_status, po.receipt_status, po.request_note, po.internal_memo, po.total_supply_amount, po.total_tax_amount, po.total_amount, po.created_at, po.updated_at, po.approved_at
FROM purchase_order po
INNER JOIN business_partner bp ON bp.partner_id = po.supplier_id AND bp.company_id = po.company_id
INNER JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = po.warehouse_id AND w.company_id = po.company_id
WHERE po.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND po.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT poi.purchase_order_item_id, poi.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, poi.product_unit_id, u.unit_code, u.unit_name, poi.ordered_qty, poi.conversion_qty, poi.base_ordered_qty, poi.received_qty, poi.unit_price, poi.tax_type, poi.supply_amount, poi.tax_amount, poi.total_amount
FROM purchase_order_item poi
INNER JOIN purchase_order po ON po.purchase_order_id = poi.purchase_order_id AND po.company_id = #{companyId}
INNER JOIN product p ON p.product_id = poi.product_id AND p.company_id = po.company_id
INNER JOIN product_unit pu ON pu.product_unit_id = poi.product_unit_id AND pu.product_id = poi.product_id
INNER JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id = pu.unit_id
WHERE poi.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}
ORDER BY poi.purchase_order_item_id

SELECT p.product_id, pu.product_unit_id, pu.conversion_qty, p.tax_type FROM product p INNER JOIN product_unit pu ON pu.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id = pu.unit_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.use_yn = 'Y' AND pu.product_unit_id = #{productUnitId} AND pu.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order ( company_id, order_no, supplier_id, warehouse_id, order_date, expected_delivery_date, request_note, internal_memo, total_supply_amount, total_tax_amount, total_amount, created_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{warehouseId}, #{orderDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{expectedDeliveryDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{requestNote, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{internalMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{totalSupplyAmount}, #{totalTaxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO purchase_order_item ( purchase_order_id, product_id, product_unit_id, ordered_qty, conversion_qty, base_ordered_qty, unit_price, tax_type, supply_amount, tax_amount, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{purchaseOrderId}, #{productId}, #{productUnitId}, #{orderedQty}, #{conversionQty}, #{baseOrderedQty}, #{unitPrice}, #{taxType}, #{supplyAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{totalAmount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_order SET supplier_id = #{supplierId}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, order_date = #{orderDate, jdbcType=DATE}, expected_delivery_date = #{expectedDeliveryDate, jdbcType=DATE}, request_note = #{requestNote, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, internal_memo = #{internalMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, total_supply_amount = #{totalSupplyAmount}, total_tax_amount = #{totalTaxAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND approval_status = 'DRAFT' AND receipt_status = 'NOT_RECEIVED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM purchase_order_item poi WHERE poi.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND poi.received_qty > 0 )
